_purpose: Ground truth for the offline replay guardrail (zero catch regression, D-05) and the per-agent calibration set (D-04): every archived should-catch run, its sealed SITE and BAND floor, and EVERY finding at SITE in state.passes[-1].findings[] adjudicated for the sealed AXIS clause (D-14). Committed before any harness or scorer candidate exists.

_rules.axis_basis: SUPERSESSIONS-v2.10.md entry 007 — the surviving row's own title OR any members[].title that is axis=true
_rules.compare_against: baseline replay, never recorded bands (41-RESEARCH: 9 drift runs)
_rules.site_match: finding.file == site.file AND some [lo,hi] in site.lines has lo <= finding.line <= hi

_scope: 29 catch runs = 26 guardrail rows (runs/ 8: triggarr-secret-in-logs run-1..3, triggarr-autoescape run-2..3 [run-1 was the v2.9 MISS and is not protected], third-organic-should-catch run-1..3; runs-v2.10/ 15: five should-catch diffs x run-1..3; runs-v2.10-phase40/final/ 3: triggarr-secret-in-logs run-1..3) + 3 calibration-only Phase-40 batch spot-check runs (guardrail=false). calibration=true marks the 21 Claude-5-era runs (runs-v2.10/ and runs-v2.10-phase40/). SITE, AXIS and floor are copied from SCORING-b3.md section 3 and SCORING-v2.10.md section 3; triggarr-session-rotation SITE is in run-tree coordinates 1564-1588 per SUPERSESSIONS-v2.10.md entry 002. Titles, hashes, bands, agents and lines are copied byte-exact from the archives (title null = the archived finding carries no title). Sealed qualifiers are never relabelled; every other survivor is adjudicated on its title, and its why names the deciding phrase. Paths are relative to docs/design/b3-ground-truth/; only scoreable run-N directories are listed.
